verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, a built-in AI agent that understands the product's data structure. Users can delegate work to it in natural language: investigating logs, building scorers, datasets and dashboards, and generating datasets. Patterns extends this by running Loop on a schedule to find recurring trace problems and suggest fixes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Loop's effectiveness, and in-depth documentation of how far delegation goes (e.g., review or approval of agent actions, limits).
